# American Academy of Forensic Sciences

> AAFS is a multidisciplinary professional organization advancing forensic science through membership, annual conferences, peer-reviewed publications, and forensic standards development.

The American Academy of Forensic Sciences (AAFS) serves forensic professionals across multiple specialties including anthropology, criminalistics, digital sciences, engineering, pathology, and more. AAFS publishes the Journal of Forensic Sciences, hosts an annual scientific conference, and provides professional development and networking opportunities for forensic practitioners and students.

## Key Topics

- American Academy of Forensic Sciences
- Journal of Forensic Sciences

## Membership

- [Membership](https://www.aafs.org/membership): AAFS membership overview, sections, and application information
- [Membership Benefits](https://www.aafs.org/membership-become-member/membership-benefits): AAFS membership benefits including journal access, conference registration, and networking
- [Membership Requirements](https://www.aafs.org/membership/membership-requirements): AAFS membership eligibility criteria across Anthropology, Criminalistics, and other sections
- [Application Information](https://www.aafs.org/membership/application-information): AAFS membership application timeline, cycles, fees, and member benefits
- [Student Affiliate](https://www.aafs.org/membership/student-affiliate): AAFS Student Affiliate membership with conference access and professional development
- [Professional Affiliate](https://www.aafs.org/membership/professional-affiliate): AAFS Professional Affiliate membership type eligibility and qualification criteria
- [Manage Your Membership Status](https://www.aafs.org/membership/manage-status): AAFS member portal for managing membership status, upgrades, and promotions
- [Pay Annual Membership Dues](https://www.aafs.org/pay-dues): AAFS membership dues payment and annual fee schedule information

## Conferences & Events

- [Meetings and Conferences](https://www.aafs.org/meetings-and-conferences): AAFS annual scientific conference in New Orleans and year-round educational events

## Organization & Leadership

- [About Us](https://www.aafs.org/about-us): AAFS mission, vision, values, and multidisciplinary professional organization overview
- [Board of Directors](https://www.aafs.org/about-us/board-directors): AAFS Board of Directors leadership and governance structure with 18 members
- [Staff](https://www.aafs.org/about-us/staff): AAFS staff directory and organization team contact information
- [Committees](https://www.aafs.org/committees): AAFS committees including Community Connections and Humanitarian Rights Resource Center
- [Get Involved](https://www.aafs.org/membership/get-involved): AAFS member involvement opportunities including committees, standards, and mentorship
